tools.name: browserbase_list_projects
tools.description: List the Browserbase projects this API key can use, with their concurrency limits. Good first call to find a projectId. Browserbase API: GET /v1/projects.

tools.name: browserbase_get_project_usage
tools.description: Get the usage figures for one project (sessions, browser time and proxy bytes, as the API returns them). Browserbase API: GET /v1/projects/{id}/usage.

tools.name: browserbase_list_sessions
tools.description: List browser sessions, newest first, with their status (RUNNING, COMPLETED, ERROR, TIMED_OUT, REQUEST_RELEASE), timing and metadata. Browserbase API: GET /v1/sessions.

tools.name: browserbase_get_session
tools.description: Get one browser session by id: status, region, start and end times, and its connection details. Browserbase API: GET /v1/sessions/{id}.

tools.name: browserbase_create_session
tools.description: Start a new cloud browser session and return its record. Starts billed browser time. Optionally keep the session open and reuse a saved context (cookies and logins). Browserbase API: POST /v1/sessions.

tools.name: browserbase_release_session
tools.description: Ask Browserbase to end a session and release its browser (status REQUEST_RELEASE). Stops billed browser time for that session. Browserbase API: POST /v1/sessions/{id}.

tools.name: browserbase_fetch_page
tools.description: Fetch one web page through Browserbase and return its status code, headers, content and content type. Browserbase API: POST /v1/fetch.

tools.name: browserbase_web_search
tools.description: Search the web through Browserbase and return matching results with titles, URLs and excerpts. Browserbase API: POST /v1/search.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "browserbase_create_session" references sensitive artifacts (cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: browserbase_create_session, browserbase_fetch_page, browserbase_web_search · Private data: browserbase_list_projects, browserbase_create_session · Public sink: browserbase_create_session, browserbase_release_session, browserbase_fetch_page, browserbase_web_search.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: browserbase_create_session, browserbase_fetch_page, browserbase_web_search · Private data: browserbase_list_projects, browserbase_create_session · Public sink: browserbase_create_session, browserbase_release_session, browserbase_fetch_page, browserbase_web_search

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
